Author: koko
Name: Housing Studio
Punchline: Furnish your house from a Housing Studio build or a MakePlace layout.
Description:
Load a .build from Housing Studio (or a MakePlace .json) and see every piece matched to what you have: already placed, in your bags, in the storeroom, or still to buy. It moves placed pieces to their exact spots, and when you put a piece down from your bags or the storeroom it sets it exactly where the design has it. In-world markers, floor filters, a dry run, a copyable shopping list, and backups of your current layout.

Use /hstudio to open it. Only works in a house or apartment you're allowed to decorate, in the game's furnishing mode.
